items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: He had the Jimmy Smith organ trio, Don Schwartz and Donald Bailey on drums -- the original Jimmy Smith.

ctx.x: I came down here -- I think it was '61 -- with Al Gray and Billy Mitchell. They had a sextet. We had a week at Peps, old Peps down there on Broad Street. He had a trumpet player -- I forgot the brother's name -- he also had arranger, Gene, who played piano as well as peck horn. That's an alto horn, looks something like your that euphonium that Kiane plays (unintelligible). But it blended, so that meant we had four horns and his drums and bass on certain arrangements. It was beautiful, beautiful sound. I stayed…

It was the following weekend, they played some clubs and we come down to play for -- they had some -- some young disc jockey around here had a -- trying out for a TV show. He had the Jimmy Smith organ trio, Don Schwartz and Donald Bailey on drums -- the original Jimmy Smith.
